glossary.definition: MCP is an open standard, introduced by Anthropic, that lets AI models connect to outside tools and data sources, like a file system, a calendar, or a company database, in one consistent way. Before MCP, every app that wanted to connect an AI model to its data needed its own custom, one-off wiring, similar to every electrical appliance needing a completely different, non-standard plug. MCP is meant to work like a universal power socket: build the connection once, and any compatible AI model can plug in.

items.title: Anthropic tiptoes into MS Office territory
items.summary: Anthropic has introduced three new types of artifacts that show the company tiptoeing into the office productivity market long dominated by Microsoft and Google. On Tuesday, the Claudefather announced Claude Sheets, Claude Whiteboards, and Claude Data, and promised the imminent arrival of Claude Meetings. These artifact types join existing ones – Docs, Slides, Design, and Motion – to form a nascent Claude-dependent productivity suite. Anthropic initially used the term artifacts to refer to shareable AI-based interactive tools, like dynamic charts.

items.title: Mercor raises $750M at $20B valuation to take AI agent evaluation to enterprises
items.summary: io Corp. today revealed that it has raised $750 million in new funding at a $20 billion valuation. Mercor provides the human expertise used to train and evaluate AI models, drawing on a network of more than 5 million domain experts. Most of that work so far has been for frontier AI labs. The new funding is aimed at taking it to enterprises in every industry, which Mercor argues need their own way to measure whether an AI agent can be trusted with a job.

items.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
items.summary: Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows. The information is revealed through links allowing Grok Build users to share their apps with others. Grok takes steps to randomize the URLs so only people who know the exact URL can access the data stored there. A design decision by developers of the platform, however, completely torpedoes that objective and makes it possible for anyone to enumerate thousands of live Grok Build projects.

items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
items.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry. OpenAI has acquired an AI travel agent called Odessia, according to Odessia’s founder, Francis Davidson. Davidson says in a post announcing the deal that he’s now working for OpenAI, helping the AI lab with the future of travel.

items.title: China’s block of SoftBank’s ABB purchase raises supply-chain questions
items.summary: The move to stop the Japanese multinational investment holding company’s acquisition has sparked concerns about the future of cross-border robotics investment.

items.title: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into a business directory with AI agents that handle customer questions
items.summary: OpenAI is opening up ChatGPT as a business platform: through a new Business Hub, companies can claim their profile, add product data, and track how users interact with them. "Business Agents" let eligible US e-commerce providers talk to customers directly inside ChatGPT. " Google My Business is Google's free tool that lets companies manage how they appear across Search and Maps, and OpenAI's new offering challenges it by placing business profiles directly inside a conversational AI interface instead. Companies can register and manage their business through a Business Hub, update their information, add product feeds with prices and availability, and track how often they're mentioned in conversations or how many clicks their website gets.

items.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
items.summary: As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of important people. He also wears a cool leather jacket. Which makes Huang's admission that he had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy - reportedly while her spying was known to US intelligence and even President Donald Trump - all the more shocking.

items.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
items.summary: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models. Kirt McMaster knows that his new operating system—Kora—won’t be for everyone, and he’s fine with that. Kora , announced on Tuesday, is designed as a desktop alternative to Windows or macOS for “the AI native, not mass market,” he says. McMaster, the company’s CEO and cofounder—who also cofounded Boost Mobile—likens his strategy to how Steve Jobs targeted creators when overhauling desktop publishing with the Mac .

items.title: PuppyGraph adds AI schema builder and MCP support to help ease enterprise agent adoption
items.summary: PuppyGraph on Tuesday said it was adding an AI-assisted graph schema builder and MCP integrations to PuppyGraph 1.0, the new version of its distributed graph query engine for enterprise data. The update is designed to help developers reduce the complexity, latency, and costs associated with letting AI agents query interconnected data across thousands of database tables and multiple platforms. The AI-assisted schema builder automatically maps existing tables into graph entities, relationships, and properties, allowing developers to review and approve the resulting schema rather than manually defining how disparate datasets connect, the Santa Clara-headquartered startup said in a statement. These schemas can be used by agents deployed to query enterprise data, giving them a predefined map of how information across different tables and systems is connected, rather than requiring them to identify relevant tables and construct complex SQL joins dynamically, in turn simplifying query generation and reducing errors and retries, it added.

items.title: TSMC October Revenue Hits Record $17.81 Bn on Skyrocketing AI Chip Demand
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) reported its highest-ever monthly revenue in October, with sales rising 59.7% year-on-year as demand for advanced chips continues to expand. The world's largest contract chipmaker posted consolidated revenue of NT 586.89 billion (approximately $17.81 billion), up 14.7% from September. Revenue for January to October reached $140 billion, marking a 43.3% increase from the corresponding period last year. The latest figures reflect growing demand for advanced semiconductor manufacturing as technology companies expand their artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure .

items.title: Midterm results will raise AI costs and compliance questions for IT leaders
items.summary: IT leaders need to quickly adapt IT strategies as AI and data centers will face more scrutiny following the US midterm elections, analysts said. Concerns around AI and data centers helped Democrats sweep the US House and Senate. Tighter restrictions, more oversight and slower approvals could slow AI deployment and raise costs. An exit poll conducted by SSRS and shared by NBC News showed that 56% of voters considered AI and data centers a major factor in their vote.

items.title: The backlash about data centers might really just be about electricity
items.summary: As voters went to the polls across the US last week, I was in Ashburn, Virginia, part of what’s known as Data Center Alley—the world’s largest data center hub. It’s also where the backlash now sweeping the country arguably first began taking shape. Driving through it is surreal. Concrete monolithic buildings loom along every major road, with names like Skybox and CloudHQ.
